children: MFN Partners, LP disclosed a 19.3% stake in RXO, Inc. common stock. The Schedule 13D, filed on Oct. 05, 2026, follows a voting and support agreement signed on Oct. 4 with C.H. Robinson tied to RXO’s announced merger. The move signals that MFN will back the deal while agreeing to important limits on transfers during the merger process.

MFN Partners agreed to support RXO’s merger with C.H. Robinson by committing to "vote ... in favor of the adoption of the Merger Agreement" and "against any Acquisition Proposal." The fund also agreed not to transfer its shares during the term of the agreement, and it accepted non-solicitation provisions, with the pact ending if the merger agreement terminates.
MFN plans to keep evaluating its position around the deal and may trade the stock as part of merger-arbitrage strategies, subject to the agreement’s terms and applicable rules.

MFN Partners, LP is a private investment partnership based in Boston, Massachusetts, advised by MFN Partners Management, LP. The firm runs a concentrated, research-driven strategy that often targets complex or event-driven situations. MFN frequently builds sizable positions and may engage in merger arbitrage when corporate transactions create opportunities.
